$comment: One finding from the model. Every protocol's findings must look like this. Limits on lengths and counts stop a confused model from flooding the report.
title: Finding

claim.description: What the model says is true, as a short sentence.

evidence.description: Exact quotes copied from the input data. Code checks that each one really appears there.

basis.description: observed = read directly from the data; inferred = a guess built on the data.

kind.description: Optional label a protocol uses to group findings, e.g. anomaly, hypothesis, device_guess.

subject.description: Optional: what the finding is about, e.g. an IP address or a column name.
